Class Player

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.gc49.server.model.Player
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Player extends Object implements Serializable
The Player class represents the server-side model of a game participant. It holds the definitive state of a player's resources (food, points), their inventory (character and building cards), and their current status within a turn (actions left to do, connection status, and track position). It also encapsulates a DataBank to keep track of complex statistics and effects.
